name: labs/davidlutton__labtoolkit
title: Agilent PSA spectrum analyser (labtoolkit AgilentE44nn)
intro: Agilent PSA spectrum analyser (labtoolkit AgilentE44nn), adapted from davidlutton/labtoolkit. It reads `identification`; sets `frequency_center`, `frequency_span`, `sweep_points`, `resolution_bandwidth` and 2 more; runs `stop_sweep`. `stop_sweep`: stop continuous sweeping (the native stop, INIT:CONTinuous OFF); it takes no input. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
